command_contract: USER_2=31011 and USER_3=31012; COMMAND_INT only, configured GCS source, frameMISSION2, version exactly1, taskID exact stored ID, unused fields zero under existing checks.

native_arrival.horizontal_radius_m: retained task radius;1 for these runs
native_arrival.inputs: AHRS estimated location in absolute frame and finite NED velocity, plus existing valid home/origin/navigation/failsafe and reference-reset guards. No simulator truth. API validity is used; no independent per-sensor age qualification claimed.
native_arrival.invalid_measurement: FAILED then request existing stock LAND-with-pause; source-inspected, not a fault campaign
native_arrival.complete: terminal task result; retain mode31 and controller target until operator mode change. No automatic land/disarm.

abort.allowed: active RUNNING or DWELLING task with valid navigation/references and stock BRAKE compiled
abort.state_after_success: ABORTED when successful mode entry invokes native exit
abort.mode_rejection: DENIED, retain actual task state; never claim ABORTED. Operator LAND fallback.
abort.duplicate: after ABORTED, acknowledge same ID without changing mode or target, including after operator LAND
abort.after_complete: reject abort; COMPLETE stays terminal; normal operator LAND remains available

other_exit: RUNNING/DWELLING external mode exit becomes INTERRUPTED; terminal COMPLETE/ABORTED/FAILED retained. No restart/rearm after exit.
